title: Articles of Agreement Spec
description: Input shape for scripts/articles_audit.mjs — a normalized description of an Articles of Agreement contract's signing identity and per-obligation enforcement clauses.

daemonIssued.description: True only if the Agent Node id was issued by the daemon (e.g. via a registrationNonce at agent.register), never self-asserted by the body.

signed.description: True only if an articlesSignature binds this specific Agent Node identity to this specific Articles contract.

clauses.description: Every obligation the Articles impose. An empty array is never treated as safe.

name.description: Short identifier for the clause, e.g. "register-with-daemon".

obligation.description: Plain-language statement of what the agent must do or refrain from doing.

enforcementMechanism.description: How the daemon actually enforces this clause. "none" is a legal-but-unsafe value: it names an unenforced obligation honestly instead of omitting the field.

daemonObservable.description: True only if the daemon can independently observe compliance or violation, not merely trust the agent's own report.

denialShape.description: For a gate-style mechanism (pre-tool-gate, hook, capability-lease, mcp-gateway): the concrete rejection the agent receives on violation (error code, refused tool call, revoked lease). Meaningless for probe/transcript-event, which only observe.
